cues.name: Count In blackout
cues.note: Black before the first hit.

cues.name: OUT OF THE BLACK (hits on blackout)
cues.note: The riff stated by guitar and kit, no bass: kicks punch red, snares crack white, crashes strobe; black between.

cues.name: · intro goes big
cues.note: The bass in (+6 dB): every layer moving, the riff's hits punching through.

cues.name: · intro phrase 2
cues.note: The riff's second phrase: every move changes.

cues.name: Verse 1
cues.note: Dark and heavy: deep red low, the beams swaying slowly; only the kit's own snare and kicks move it.

cues.name: Chorus
cues.note: Up: crossing beams, a chase on the towers, comets on the bars; the singer's key held through it.

cues.name: Instrumental (hits on blackout)
cues.note: No voice: hard on/off — kicks swap sides on the towers, snares crack the movers white, the tom fill runs across the strips.

cues.name: Verse 2
cues.note: Darker and heavier than verse 1's sway: the beams circle the singer and fall away; snares pulse the beams, kicks the towers.

cues.name: Interlude (hits on ember, blackout)
cues.note: Strobe-style out of a red ember: kicks red on the strips, snares white on the full rig, the tom run a chase across both sides.

cues.name: Chorus (2)
cues.note: Hotter than chorus 1, and other moves: the fire split chasing, kicking beams, scanners, lightning on the wall.

cues.name: Hook (hits on ember, blackout)
cues.note: The signature figure, bass out: kicks swap the towers side to side, snares the movers white; at the lift strips and towers, the last bar the full rig.

cues.name: Band In (hits on blackout)
cues.note: The figure with the bass back, true black: every kick the full rig red, every snare white; strobe on the snares in the second half.

cues.name: Interlude (2) (hits on blackout)
cues.note: Harder than the first interlude: every kick the full rig, every snare a strobe; the band out on 3 of 107.

cues.name: Chorus (3)
cues.note: The last chorus, everything at full: snares crack the rig white side to side, crashes strobe.

cues.name: · Chorus (3) strobe
cues.note: Its last bar strobes.

cues.name: Bridge  Instrumental
cues.note: Insane but dark: fast red beams sweeping, strobe flicks and meteors in a black room; kicks flick the towers red side to side.

cues.name: Bridge
cues.note: Pulled back to the voice so what follows hits harder.

cues.name: Breakdown - Dropped
cues.note: The kit out after the crash on 137: guitar alone, embers.

cues.name: · bass in
cues.note: The bass back on 145; the snare fill in 147-148 builds on the towers.

cues.name: Breakdown - FULL
cues.note: The craziest part of the song: everything at once, strobing, every hit punching the rig to full on top.

cues.name: Hook (2) (hits on red blackout)
cues.note: The figure again, loudest: kicks red on pars and strips, snares white towers swapping sides, the beams joining halfway.

cues.name: · Hook (2) lift blackout
cues.note: True black, white-ready: every hit the full rig, the snares strobing in the last four bars, the tom fills a chase.

cues.name: Hits (hits on blackout)
cues.note: Kick and crash together on 1 and 3: the full rig and a strobe; the kick run in 185 builds layer by layer.

cues.name: Breakdown
cues.note: Carrying the energy: chases and crossing beams; snares white on the bars.

cues.name: · backbeat
cues.note: The kit to a straight backbeat on 195: the towers' snares go white side to side.

cues.name: SWELL (hits on ember, blackout)
cues.note: The crash on 203 out of the ember, then the ring.

cues.name: · swell
cues.note: The swell: the kit rolling to the loudest bars of the song.

cues.name: Stop blackout
cues.note: The stop in bar 212.

cues.name: END
cues.note: The last hit (213, a sixteenth late) flashes the rig white; deep red rings out under it.

cues.name: blackout
cues.note: Fade with the ring-out to black.

hits on blackout.about: every layer out and coloured for the punch that comes: white-ready, true black between the hits

hits on ember.about: out but for a deep red ember on the wall: the hits land white out of a glow, not out of nothing

hits on red blackout.about: every layer out, the towers and strips red-ready: a kick punches red, a white bump cracks white

Out Of The Black.about: Out Of The Black: moody and loud — blood red washes, orange and amber accents, deep red for the dark corners; white only in the hits
